limbs.note: A provider-signed claim receipt binding model, usage, outcome, issuance time and an anti-replay identity. Reserved. No provider issues a qualifying artifact, so no appraisal has ever recorded this limb.

An organization aggregate the server retrieves from a provider-operated administrative interface under a credential the enrolled organization's administrator supplied. It corroborates a board at a stated interval and never binds an individual claim.

unpersisted_fields.schema_version: The version of the record shape, which the table expresses by being the shape it is. A column would let one row claim a schema the surrounding DDL does not implement, and migrations are how this repository changes a table's version.
unpersisted_fields.authority: A constant on the record and therefore not a fact about a row. A column holding one value for every row that will ever exist records nothing and invites a row that disagrees.
unpersisted_fields.client_influence: A constant reading `none`, for the same reason as the authority above: storing it per row would make it a thing a row could vary.
unpersisted_fields.attestation.class: D-100, constant. Stored per row it would imply some appraisal somewhere carries a different attestation class, and none does or can.
unpersisted_fields.attestation.basis: D-100, constant. It describes what kind of figure every claim in this system is, which is a property of the contract rather than of a row.
unpersisted_fields.attestation.assesses: D-100, constant. The whole appraisal grades a self-report; a column repeating that on every row records the contract, not the appraisal.

column_only.created_at: When the row was written, which is not when the appraisal took effect. `effective_from` is the record's own answer to that and can precede or follow the write; keeping both is what stops a backfilled appraisal being read as a late one.

record_only_fields.authority: A constant: every appraisal is the server verifier's, and a wire field for it would be a field a client could disagree with. D-267 makes the authority a property of the record's definition rather than of the instance.
record_only_fields.client_influence: A constant reading `none`. Encoding it would create the one thing it denies: a slot on the wire whose value could be anything other than none.
record_only_fields.attestation.class: D-100. Fixed at `none` because no provider offers an individual-account attestation path, so there is nothing for an instance to vary and a varying wire field would imply there is.
record_only_fields.attestation.basis: D-100. Fixed at `self-reported-at-source` for the same reason as the class: it states what kind of thing every figure in this system is, not what this one is.
record_only_fields.attestation.assesses: D-100. Fixed at `self-report-quality`, which is the sentence the whole appraisal exists to qualify: it grades a self-report and never confirms one.
record_only_fields.public_state: Derived: it follows from `awarded_profile_id`, which label 14 carries. Putting it on the wire would let the two be stated apart, and a public state arriving beside a profile that does not imply it is exactly the client-selected state the record forbids.
